title: Garrison of Osgiliath
text: <keyword>Fortification.</keyword> When you play this condition, you may spot a <symbol>gondor</symbol> Man to place 2 <symbol>gondor</symbol> tokens here. <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Discard this condition or remove a <symbol>gondor</symbol> token from here to make a <symbol>gondor</symbol> Man strength +1.
